info.name: HashLHDN API v1.1.2
info.description:
HashLHDN MyInvois Middleware API - Malaysia's e-invoicing system (LHDN)

## Overview
This collection provides endpoints for:
- JWT Authentication with access/refresh tokens
- 4 Invoice Submission types (Consolidate, JustSave, Buyer, Personal)
- Document operations (List, Status, PDF, Cancel)
- User, Role, and Company management

## IMPORTANT: Request Body Format

| Endpoint | Body Key | Format |
|----------|----------|--------|
| **submit-consolidate** | `invoices` | Array of invoice objects |
| **submit-buyer** | `invoice` | Single invoice object |
| **submit-personal** | `invoice` | Single invoice object |
| **submit-justsave** | `invoice` | Single invoice object |

## Authentication
All endpoints except `/health` and `/auth/login` require JWT Bearer token.

## Version
v1.1.2 - Fixed request body schemas, digital signing support for v1.1 documents

## Base URL
- Development: http://localhost:3000
- Production: Configure in environment

request.description:
Authenticate user and receive access + refresh tokens.

**Token Expiry:**
- Access Token: 15 minutes
- Refresh Token: 7 days

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "accessToken": "eyJ...",
    "refreshToken": "eyJ...",
    "user": {
      "id": "...",
      "email": "...",
      "name": "...",
      "role": { "name": "...", "permissions": [...] },
      "companies": [...]
    }
  }
}
```

Exchange refresh token for new access token. Use when access token expires.

item.name: HashLHDN Submission
item.description:
Invoice submission endpoints for Malaysia's MyInvois e-invoicing system.

**Permission Required:** `submit:invoice`

## CRITICAL: Request Body Format

| Endpoint | Body Key | Format |
|----------|----------|--------|
| **submit-consolidate** | `invoices` | Array of invoice objects |
| **submit-buyer** | `invoice` | Single invoice object |
| **submit-personal** | `invoice` | Single invoice object |
| **submit-justsave** | `invoice` | Single invoice object |

## Required Fields (ALL endpoints)

**Invoice:**
- `invoiceNumber`, `invoiceDate`, `amount`, `discount`, `rounding`, `taxAmount`, `total`, `items`

**Buyer (required for buyer/personal):**
- `name`, `idType`, `idValue`, `address`, `city`, `state`, `postalCode`

**Items (each item must have):**
- `description`, `quantity`, `unitPrice`, `taxCode`, `taxRate`, `taxAmount`, `total`

**Document Versions:**
- `1.0` - Basic submission (no signing)
- `1.1` - With digital signature (X.509/XAdES)

**Tax Codes:**
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 01 | Sales Tax (SST) |
| 02 | Service Tax |
| 03 | Tourism Tax |
| 04 | High-Value Goods Tax |
| 05 | Sales Tax on Low Value Goods |
| 06 | Not Applicable |
| E | Tax Exemption |

request.description:

**Use Case:** Aggregate daily B2C sales into a single invoice for LHDN compliance.

**Buyer TIN:** Uses generic TIN `EI00000000010` (General Public) for consolidated invoices.

**Document Version:** Set to `1.1` for digital signing.

```json

  "data": {
    "submissionUid": "...",

    "rejectedDocuments": [...]
```

request.description:
Submit B2B invoice with buyer TIN and BRN.

**Note:** Uses `invoice` (singular object), NOT `invoices` array.

**Required Buyer Fields:**
- `tin` - Tax Identification Number (validated by LHDN)
- `idType` - Must be `BRN` (Business Registration Number)
- `idValue` - Business registration number
- `name`, `address`, `city`, `state`, `postalCode` - All required

**Required Item Fields:**
- `description`, `quantity`, `unitPrice`, `taxCode`, `taxRate`, `taxAmount`, `total`

**State Codes:**
| Code | State |
|------|-------|
| 01 | Johor |
| 02 | Kedah |
| 03 | Kelantan |
| 04 | Melaka |
| 05 | Negeri Sembilan |
| 06 | Pahang |
| 07 | Pulau Pinang |
| 08 | Perak |
| 09 | Perlis |
| 10 | Selangor |
| 11 | Terengganu |
| 12 | Sabah |
| 13 | Sarawak |
| 14 | WP Kuala Lumpur |
| 15 | WP Labuan |
| 16 | WP Putrajaya |
| 17 | Not Applicable |

Submit B2C invoice with buyer NRIC (Malaysian IC).

**CRITICAL:** Uses `invoice` (singular object), NOT `invoices` array!

**Required Buyer Fields:**
- `name` - Buyer full name
- `idType` - Must be `NRIC` (literal value)
- `idValue` - Malaysian IC number (12 digits)
- `address` - Street address (string, NOT object)
- `city`, `state`, `postalCode` - All required

**Required Item Fields:**
- `description`, `quantity`, `unitPrice`, `taxCode`, `taxRate`, `taxAmount`, `total`

**Auto TIN:** System uses generic TIN `EI00000000010` for personal invoices.

**WARNING for v1.1:** LHDN validates NRIC against taxpayer database. Use taxCode `06` (Not Applicable) for B2C to avoid strict buyer validation.

**ID Types:**
- `NRIC` - Malaysian IC (12 digits)
- `PASSPORT` - Passport number (for foreigners)
- `ARMY` - Army ID

item.name: Documents
item.description:
Document management operations - list, status check, PDF download, and cancellation.

**Permission Required:** `read:documents` for viewing, `cancel:documents` for cancellation

query.description: Filter by status: valid, invalid, cancelled, pending

request.description:
Get current status of a document from LHDN.

**Status Values:**
- `pending` - Submitted, awaiting LHDN processing
- `valid` - Accepted by LHDN (has longId)
- `invalid` - Rejected by LHDN (has errors)
- `cancelled` - Cancelled by user

**Response (Valid):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "status": "valid",
    "longId": "ABC123...",
    "validatedAt": "2026-01-20T10:05:00Z"
  }
}
```

Download the official LHDN PDF for a validated document.

**Requirements:**
- Document must have `valid` status
- Returns PDF binary with `application/pdf` content type

**Error:** Returns 404 if document not found or not yet validated.

Cancel a submitted document.

**Requirements:**
- Document must have `valid` status
- Must be within LHDN's cancellation window (72 hours)
- Requires `cancel:documents` permission

**Request Body:**
- `reason` (required) - Cancellation reason for audit trail

**Note:** Cancellation is irreversible and reported to LHDN.

Submit a previously saved draft invoice to LHDN MyInvois.

**Workflow:**
1. Create invoice with `SaveInvoice: true` via `/api/v1/documents/submit`
2. Receive `trackingId` with status `DRAFT`
3. When ready, call this endpoint with the `trackingId`
4. System retrieves draft, transforms to UBL, submits to LHDN

**Request Body:**
- `documentVersion` - Optional. "1.0" or "1.1" (default: "1.1")

**Response:**
```json
{
  "trackingId": "HASH-XXXXX-YYYYY",
  "invoiceId": "LHDN-UUID-HERE",
  "status": "SUBMITTED",
  "message": "Draft buyer invoice submitted successfully to LHDN",
  "submittedAt": "2026-01-20T10:30:00Z"
}
```

**Errors:**
- `DRAFT_NOT_FOUND` - No draft found with given trackingId
- `INVALID_STATUS` - Invoice is not in DRAFT status
- Validation errors from LHDN if document fails validation
List all users with pagination. Returns user details including role and company assignments.

**Required Fields:**

Delete a user.

item.name: Roles
item.description:
Role management endpoints.

**Permission Required:** `manage:roles`

**Available Permissions:**
- `submit:invoice` - Submit invoices to LHDN
- `read:documents` - View documents
- `cancel:documents` - Cancel documents
- `manage:users` - CRUD users
- `manage:roles` - CRUD roles
- `manage:companies` - CRUD companies

request.description: List all roles with their permissions.

Create a new role with specified permissions.

**Example Roles:**
- Admin: All permissions
- Invoice Clerk: submit:invoice, read:documents
- Viewer: read:documents only
Get role details by ID.
Update role name and/or permissions.

Delete a role.

**Restriction:** Cannot delete roles that have users assigned.
List all companies the user has access to.

Create a new company.

**Required Fields:**
- `name` - Company name
- `tin` - Tax Identification Number (for LHDN)
- `brn` - Business Registration Number
Get company details by ID.
Update company details.

Delete a company.

**Restriction:** Cannot delete companies that have documents.

Set or update the MyInvois API credentials for a company.

**Security:** Credentials are encrypted at rest using AES-256.

**Required for:** Submitting invoices to LHDN. Without credentials, company cannot submit to MyInvois.

**Obtain from:** LHDN MyInvois portal (https://myinvois.hasil.gov.my)

item.name: Legacy Submit (Original Format)
item.description:
Unified submission endpoint supporting clients original Postman format with PascalCase fields and flag-based routing.

**Supported Flags:**
- `ConsolidatedInvoice: true` - Consolidate multiple items into one e-invoice
- `SaveInvoice: true` - Save to database without LHDN submission (JustSave)
- No flags + `customer` with `IdType: BRN` - B2B invoice
- No flags + `customer` with `IdType: NRIC` - B2C invoice

**Format Notes:**
- Accepts both PascalCase (CompanyId, Tin) and camelCase (companyId, tin)
- Uses `customer` object instead of `buyer`
- Uses `Address1` instead of `address`, `StateCode` instead of `state`

{
  "CompanyId": "{{companyId}}",
  "ConsolidatedInvoice": false,
  "SaveInvoice": false,
  "invoices": [
    {
      "invoiceNumber": "INV-UNIFIED-001",
      "invoiceDate": "2026-01-20T10:00:00Z",
      "amount": 100.00,
      "discount": 0,
      "rounding": 0,
      "taxAmount": 0,
      "total": 100.00,
      "customer": {
        "Tin": "C12345678901",
        "Name": "Test Buyer Sdn Bhd",
        "Address1": "123 Test Street",
        "City": "Kuala Lumpur",
        "StateCode": "14",
        "PostalCode": "50000",
        "IdType": "BRN",
        "IdValue": "202001012345"
      },
      "items": [
        {
          "description": "Test Service",

request.description:
Unified submission endpoint supporting multiple invoice types through flags.

**Flags:**
- Set `ConsolidatedInvoice: true` for consolidated daily sales
- Set `SaveInvoice: true` to save without LHDN submission
- With `customer.IdType: BRN` → B2B invoice
- With `customer.IdType: NRIC` → B2C invoice

**Response:**
```json

  "trackingId": "HASH-XXXXX-YYYYY",
  "invoiceId": "LHDN-UUID-HERE",
  "status": "SUBMITTED",
  "message": "Invoice submitted successfully"
}
```
